title: A composition of integral ring maps is integral
statement: Let $R\to S$ and $S\to T$ be homomorphisms of commutative rings such that $S$ is integral over $R$ and $T$ is integral over $S$ (every element is a root of a monic polynomial with coefficients in the image of the base). Then $T$ is integral over $R$ via the composite $R\to S\to T$.
